rows.label: bf05140150_0010
rows.name:
When he was 2 years old, he was brought
to this village by his mother.

rows.label: bf05140150_0020
rows.name:
Whether it was war or a Divine Beast reaching its end,
it seems they were driven from their home.

rows.label: bf05140150_0030
rows.name:
By the time they arrived here,
she was terribly weakened.

rows.label: bf05140150_0040
rows.name: She said, "Take care of Rex," and...

rows.label: bf05140150_0070
rows.name:
We found his body about
three kilts away from here.

rows.label: bf05140150_0080
rows.name:
He probably couldn't make it here,
even though he was so close...
